# indie.solutions

> indie.solutions is a private AI Brain for companies. It connects a company's knowledge, answers questions in plain language with the source for every answer, and puts that knowledge to work in custom apps and AI agents. It runs on a device in the company's own office, so data stays under the company's control. indie.solutions is a product of brainbot GmbH in Mainz, Germany, founded in 2000 as a spin-off of the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI).

The AI Brain is an alternative to cloud AI tools like ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot for companies that want to keep their data in-house. Prices are per device, for any number of users. Nothing a team asks or stores is used to train AI models. Access is read-only by default, and each team only sees the knowledge it has been given access to.

## Software

Every device comes with this software preinstalled:

- AI Brain: one knowledge base for the whole company. It connects to email, drives and code (GitLab, GitHub) where they already are, and answers questions with the source for every answer. File servers, network drives and more systems, like SharePoint, Teams, Confluence, Notion, SAP, Salesforce and HubSpot, can be connected on request.
- AI Agent Command Center: one dashboard for custom apps and AI agents that work with the company's approved data. Agents show each step, and people approve actions before anything is final.
- Agent Studio: a protected area for every team, with its own knowledge and rules for what its agents may do.

Users have their own accounts. Company login (SSO or LDAP) is available as an add-on.

## Packages

One price for the hardware, the setup, and 12 months of the AI Brain with updates, support and device protection. Prices are net, plus VAT.

- Essential, €20,900: for small teams, with the indie.box, a compact AI server for the office.
- Plus, €26,400: for small teams that want faster answers, with the indie.box plus the indie.booster (NVIDIA RTX 5090).
- Performance, €27,400: for teams that use AI all day, with the indie.workstation.
- Enterprise, custom quote: for large organizations with 100 to 1,000+ users, with indie.rack servers.

Every package includes delivery, a two-day setup workshop, two custom apps, 12 months of the AI Brain (up to 18,000 pages and 2,500 questions a month) and 12 months of Priority support.

After 12 months, customers only pay for what they intend to use, per device:

- AI Brain plans: free (up to 1,000 pages), €300, €1,200 or €3,500 a month.
- Updates, support and device protection: €25, €149, €349 or €790 a month. The higher plans include repair or a replacement device shipped the next business day.

Minimum term 12 months, then cancel with 3 months notice. Support runs Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm CET.
